name: Rill
description: This MCP server queries metrics in your Rill project to answer questions, surface trends, generate reports, and explore your data from new angles. Every result includes a link back to the relevant Rill dashboard so you can verify the data yourself.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.rilldata.com/v1/orgs/demo/projects/rill-openrtb-prog-ads/runtime/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rill MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rill provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_views, get_metrics_view, query_metrics_view, and query_metrics_view_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rill?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rill in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Rill requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rill is developed by Rill Data, Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
